statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The denial reason code was CO-197
The patient has recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture the arrhythmic burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm changes to guide further management
The diagnosis codes submitted were I47.1 and I34.0
